versions.changelog:
- Now requires Aliyun CLI version 3.3.3 or higher (previously 3.3.1).  
- Added explicit steps to run `aliyun plugin update` to keep CLI plugins up-to-date.
- The `--user-agent` parameter must now include the skill name for all CLI commands.
- Installation and CLI requirements in documentation updated for improved clarity and compliance.
- Minor clarifications and corrections in step-by-step guides and validation instructions.

Initial release – enables querying and analysis of PAI-FeatureStore FeatureDB usage statistics.

- Supports querying daily read/write totals, project-level, and feature view statistics within a date range.
- Allows cost estimation based on official pricing and regional data.
- Enforces secure authentication practices; never exposes or requests sensitive credentials.
- Requires explicit user confirmation for all parameters; does not assume defaults.
- Limits usage strictly to querying FeatureDB usage and cost—other requests are politely declined.
- Provides clear error handling and user prompts for all parameter and resource selection steps.
